decisions.reason: Encrypted secondary communication remains core to the firm's trusted second-channel offering and likely still attracts demand.
The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture supports the firm's integrated identity solutions and remains strategically important.
QR-code-based hardware tokens are increasingly replaced by mobile app authentication, making this niche product a likely discontinuation candidate.
Payment network security compliance remains in demand due to ongoing regulatory requirements, so the suite is worth keeping.
